breakthrough: The platform follows the user and composes the right interface everywhere
outcome: Make FreeStack available as a continuous intelligence layer across desktop, mobile, home, vehicle, headset, and edge devices

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Ambient Computing Fabric Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Ambient Computing Fabric Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed services, routes, resources, events, and placement state required to make freestack available as a continuous intelligence layer across desktop, mobile, home, vehicle, headset, and edge devices, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for all runtimes, devices, models, applications, data planes, and user experiences; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Ambient Computing Fabric Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: make freestack available as a continuous intelligence layer across desktop, mobile, home, vehicle, headset, and edge devices.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Ambient Computing Fabric Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Ambient Computing Fabric Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using collective planning, multimodal reasoning, distributed optimization, simulation, and adaptive orchestration.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Ambient Computing Fabric Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the unified command center, spatial interface, conversational desktop, and developer SDK, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Ambient Computing Fabric into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Ambient Computing Fabric Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Ambient Computing Fabric Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: The platform follows the user and composes the right interface everywhere. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.

title: FreeStack Ambient Computing Fabric
